The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026 for the CBT 1 examination under CEN No. 07/2025 on 26th August 2026 at 5:00 PM. Candidates who appeared for the RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT 1 exam can now check their individual scores through the official RRB scorecard login portal.

Candidates can log in using their Registration Number and Password/Date of Birth to check their CBT 1 marks, normalised marks and qualifying status. The RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 result was earlier declared on 24th August 2026, and candidates shortlisted in CBT 1 will be eligible to appear for CBT 2.

RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026 Released

The RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 has been released on 26th August 2026. The scorecard login facility became available from 5:00 PM. Candidates who appeared for CBT 1 under CEN 07/2025 can use their login credentials to check their individual performance.

The scorecard allows candidates to check their marks and qualifying status for the next stage of the recruitment process. Candidates shortlisted through CBT 1 will be eligible to appear for the RRB NTPC UG CBT 2 examination scheduled for 17th September 2026.

Details Mentioned on the RRB NTPC UG Scorecard

Candidates should carefully check the information displayed on their RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026 after logging in. The scorecard may contain details including:

  • Candidate's Name
  • Roll Number
  • Application/Registration Number
  • Category
  • Exam Name
  • CBT 1 Marks
  • Normalised Marks, where applicable
  • Qualifying Status
  • Details related to the next stage of selection

How to Download the RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026

  1. Visit the official website of your respective Railway Recruitment Board or open the official RRB scorecard login portal.
  2. Look for the link related to "RRB NTPC Undergraduate CEN 07/2025 CBT 1 Scorecard".
  3. Click on the scorecard or marks login link.
  4. Enter your Registration/Application Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Enter the security pin or captcha, if displayed on the login page.
  6. Click on the Submit/Login button.
  7. Your RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Check your marks and qualifying status carefully.
  9. Download the scorecard and save a copy for future reference.

Required Details for Scorecard Login

  • Registration Number / Application Number
  • Password or Date of Birth, as required on the login portal
  • Security pin/captcha, if displayed

Candidates who have forgotten their registration number should check the confirmation email or SMS received during the application process. They can also use the registration-number recovery facility provided by RRB, wherever available.

Important Instructions

  • The RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026 has been released on 26th August 2026, with the login facility available from 5:00 PM.
  • Due to heavy traffic after the scorecard release, the official login portal may load slowly for some candidates.
  • If the scorecard page does not open immediately, candidates should try again after some time instead of repeatedly refreshing the page.
  • Candidates should verify their marks, category and qualifying status carefully after opening the scorecard.
  • The individual scorecard is different from the zone-wise CBT 1 result/shortlist PDF.
  • Qualified candidates should keep a copy of the scorecard for future stages of the recruitment process.
  • Candidates should rely only on official RRB websites and official login portals for checking their scores and recruitment status.

The result includes the Main Merit List of candidates selected after the written examination and interview rounds. Interviews for candidates who cleared the written exam were held from 6 July 2026 to 16 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this recruitment can now check their selection status through the official RPSC website.

How to Check and Download RPSC Assistant Professor Result 2026

Candidates can follow these steps to download the result PDF and check their selection status:

  1. Visit the official RPSC website at rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.
  2. Go to the Results or News & Events section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link for "Assistant Professor Result 2026."
  4. The Final Result and Main List PDF will open or download automatically.
  5. Press Ctrl + F and enter your roll number to search for your name in the PDF.
  6. If your roll number appears in the Main List, you have been provisionally selected. Follow the College Education Department's instructions for the next steps.

What Information Does the RPSC Assistant Professor Result PDF Contain?

The official Final Result PDF released by RPSC generally includes the following details:

  • Candidate's Roll Number
  • Merit Rank
  • Main Selection List
  • Name of the recruitment and examination (Assistant Professor Competitive Examination 2023)
  • Name of the recruiting body (RPSC)
  • Important instructions for selected candidates

The result PDF contains a list of roll numbers and does not include personal contact details. Candidates should verify their status only through the official RPSC website.

How Was the RPSC Assistant Professor Merit List Prepared?

The Final Merit List has been prepared by RPSC based on the combined performance of candidates in the written examination and the interview, as per the applicable service rules. Candidates who met the prescribed cut-off and merit criteria in both stages have been included in the Main List. Candidates whose names do not appear in the Main List may be considered later if RPSC releases a Reserve List or any further official update.

Also Read: Telangana High Court Office Subordinate Hall Ticket 2026

Next Steps for Selected Candidates

Candidates whose names appear in the Main List need to complete the following steps before final appointment:

  • Document Verification (DV): Selected candidates must submit original documents along with self-attested photocopies.
  • Eligibility Verification: Academic and eligibility criteria will be verified by the department.
  • Medical Examination: Required only if specified by the department.
  • Appointment Letter: Issued by the College Education Department after successful verification.
  • Joining Process: To be completed on the date specified by the department.

Documents Required for RPSC Assistant Professor Document Verification

Candidates called for document verification should carry the following original documents along with self-attested photocopies:

  • 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates
  • Graduation and Post-Graduation certificates
  • NET/SET/Ph.D. certificate, where applicable
  • Aadhaar Card or other valid photo ID
  • Printed copy of the RPSC Assistant Professor application form
  • RPSC Admit Card and Result/Interview Call Letter
  • Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC), where applicable
  • EWS Certificate, where applicable
  • PwBD Certificate, where applicable
  • Rajasthan Domicile Certificate, where required
  • Passport-size colour photographs
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), if currently employed in a government department
  • Any other document specified by RPSC or the College Education Department

Also Read: RRB NTPC UG Scorecard 2026

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Check the result only through the official RPSC website; avoid relying on unofficial sources for roll number confirmation.
  • Keep all original certificates ready ahead of document verification.
  • Candidates not featured in the Main List should watch the official website for any Reserve List update rather than assuming they have been rejected outright.
  • Final appointment is subject to successful completion of document and eligibility verification.

Important Remarks Recorded During Document Verification

The official result document lists specific reasons for candidates being declared "Not Eligible" despite qualifying in the written exam. The most common reasons cited include:

  • Non-creamy layer certificate not submitted for the correct financial year (FY 2023-2024, as required by the advertisement), or a later-dated/invalid certificate submitted instead

  • Additional qualification certificates, if any

  • Any other proof as required by law or as applicable

  • Appointment letters will be issued between 1 September 2026 and 30 September 2026.
  • Selected candidates must collect their appointment letter in person from the Office of the Manager (Personnel), 2nd Floor, CIDCO Bhavan, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, between 2:30 PM and 5:30 PM on working days.
  • Appointment letters will not be sent by post or email.
  • The result has been published based on information and documents submitted by candidates during document verification.
  • CIDCO reserves the right to revise, amend, modify, or cancel the result wholly or partly without prior notice, in case of any error, omission, discrepancy, or subsequent verification finding.
  • If any document, certificate, declaration, or information submitted by a candidate is later found to be false, incorrect, incomplete, invalid, or ineligible, that candidate's candidature or selection is liable to be cancelled.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) declared the UPSC CAPF Assistant Commandant Result 2026 through an official press note on 25 August 2026. The result covers the written examination stage of the Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination, 2026, held on 19 July 2026. Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the released list have provisionally qualified for the Physical Standards Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), to be conducted by the Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) as the nodal force.

This article covers the direct result PDF link, the full list format, important dates, document submission requirements, and answers to common questions candidates are searching for right now.

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Services Board
Post Name Officer in Grade 'B' (General) - Direct Recruitment (DR)
Exam Stage Phase-II (Mains) Examination
Exam Date 25th July 2026
Result Status Declared - Interview shortlist released
Result Declared On 22nd August 2026
Next Stage Interview and Personality Assessment
Official Website rbi.org.in

RBI Grade B Mains Result 2026: Important Dates

  • Phase-II (Mains) Exam Date: 25th July 2026
  • Result Declaration Date: 22nd August 2026
  • Last Date to Submit Documents for Interview: 2nd September 2026

RBI Grade B Interview Shortlist: How Many Candidates Made the List?

As per the official PDF, 127 roll numbers have been shortlisted for the Interview stage of the RBI Grade B (General) DR recruitment. Candidates can verify their roll number by opening the official PDF and using Ctrl+F to search.

How to Check RBI Grade B Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI website: rbi.org.in.
  2. Go to the "Opportunities @ RBI" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on "Current Vacancies" or the recruitment notification link.
  4. Open the link for the Phase-II result for Officers in Grade 'B' (General) DR.
  5. The result PDF will open, listing all shortlisted roll numbers.
  6. Use Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  7. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Direct Result PDF Link: Download RBI Grade B Mains Result 2026 PDF

What Happens After the RBI Grade B Mains Result?

Shortlisted candidates move to the Interview stage, followed by a Personality Assessment. RBI has specified the following process:

  • Interview Call Letter: Sent by email from [email protected]. Candidates must check their registered email inbox, including spam/junk folders, regularly.
  • Personality Assessment: A link and instructions will be emailed to shortlisted candidates, to be completed within 5 days of receipt.
  • Interview Schedule: Date, time, and venue will be communicated via the call letter. Not Yet Announced separately on the website.
  • No Change Requests: Requests to change the interview date, time, or venue will not be entertained.

Documents Required for RBI Grade B Interview 2026

Shortlisted candidates must email their BIODATA and scanned documents to [email protected] by 2nd September 2026.

Document Instruction
BIODATA Duly filled, scanned, submitted as a separate PDF
Proof of Date of Birth Matriculation/SSLC certificate only
Educational Certificates All semester/year marksheets and degree/diploma certificate
OBC Candidates OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate and declaration
SC/ST Candidates Latest caste certificate in prescribed format
EWS Candidates Income and Asset Certificate for FY 2025-26
PwBD Candidates Disability certificate; medical certificate for scribe/compensatory time, if applicable
Experience Certificates From employer(s), with post, duties, and duration
NOC Required for current Government/PSU/Autonomous Body employees

Documents to Carry (Original) on Interview Day

  • Interview Call Letter with photograph affixed
  • Photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, etc.)
  • Proof of Date of Birth
  • Educational certificates and marksheets
  • Caste/EWS/PwBD certificates, if applicable
  • Experience and NOC certificates, if applicable

Important Instructions for Shortlisted Candidates

  • Regularly check your registered email, including spam folders, for the interview call letter.
  • Bring original documents plus one self-attested photocopy set to the interview.
  • The email subject line for document submission should follow RBI's prescribed format: Registration Number - Candidate Name - Recruitment of Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) - General Cadre.
  • RBI reserves the right to rectify any inadvertent errors in the published result.

Punjab National Bank (PNB) has released the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Local Bank Officer (LBO) online written examination held on 4 January 2026. The individual scorecard link went live on the official recruitment page on 1 August 2026 and can be accessed through a registration-based login on the ibpsreg.ibps.in portal. This article explains how to download your scorecard, what it contains, the qualifying marks, and the last date to access it.

Direct Link to Check PNB LBO Score Card 2026

Particulars Details
Organization Punjab National Bank (PNB)
Post Name Local Bank Officer (LBO), Scale I / JMGS-I
Recruitment Notification Date 3 November 2025
Online Written Exam Date 4 January 2026
Written Exam Result / LLPT-Interview Call Letter 24 April 2026
Final Result Declared 23 June 2026
Scorecard Release Date 1 August 2026
Scorecard Portal ibpsreg.ibps.in
Login Credentials Required Registration/Application Number + Password or Date of Birth

Scorecard Download Window Closes 31 August 2026, 11:55 PM

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

PNB LBO Written Exam Qualifying Marks (Cut Off)

As reported by exam-preparation portals covering this recruitment cycle, candidates were required to clear both an overall cut off and a minimum sectional cut off in the online written test:

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section
General / EWS 40%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD 35%

Note: These sectional cut off percentages are drawn from exam-reporting sources and are consistent with the standard IBPS-pattern cut off structure used in this recruitment; they are Not Available Officially as an explicitly stated figure on PNB's own notice text reviewed for this article. Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. This detail is Not Available Officially on PNB's recruitment notice board and should be treated as unconfirmed until verified against the official result document.

Documents Required at the Time of Document Verification / Joining

  • Printed copy of the PNB LBO Score Card 2026
  • Final Result / Provisional Selection intimation
  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Proof of post-qualification banking experience (as applicable to the LBO eligibility criteria)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Also Read: UPSSSC VDO Supplementary Result 2026

Important Instructions

  • The scorecard link is active only for a limited window (1 August to 31 August 2026). Download it before the window closes.
  • Use your registration number rather than your name to search for your record, since candidate names can repeat.
  • Report any discrepancy in personal details on the scorecard to PNB/IBPS immediately rather than proceeding with an incorrect document.
  • PNB has issued a public notice warning candidates against paying any money to anyone for interview calls, selection, or appointment. The bank does not charge any fee for these purposes.
  • Keep your scorecard along with your final result document for document verification and joining formalities.

The 614 vacancies were distributed across the following regions:

Region Vacancies

Under the J&K region, major district-wise allocations included Srinagar (75), Jammu (75), Baramulla (35), Anantnag (30), and Budgam (30), among other districts. The Rest of India (ROI) vacancies were allocated to clusters including Delhi, Mumbai, Lucknow, Bangalore, and Mohali.

Selection Process and Exam Pattern

Selection for JK Bank Apprentice 2026 is based on an online written examination followed by document verification. There is no interview stage.

Section Questions Marks Duration
General Awareness & English 50 50 30 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning 50 50 30 minutes
Total 100 100 60 minutes
  • Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for each wrong answer.

  • A waitlist of 50% of the notified vacancies is maintained for one year from the result date or until the next recruitment exercise, whichever is earlier.

Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend structured as follows:

  • ₹13,500 per month total (₹9,000 from the Bank + ₹4,500 from the Government via DBT)
  • An additional conveyance allowance of ₹1,250
  • No other allowances are provided

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Keep your registration number and login credentials handy while checking the result.
  • Cross-check your name, roll number, and category details on the result carefully.
  • Selection under this recruitment does not guarantee employment in J&K Bank after the apprenticeship period ends.
  • Domicile candidates of J&K and Ladakh are eligible for bonus marks and age relaxation in future Banking Associate recruitment, as per the original notification.
  • Keep checking the official website for updates on document verification and further stages.

The exact number of vacancies filled through this reserve list, bank-wise or state-wise breakup, is not available in the official notification. IBPS has stated only that more candidates have been provisionally allotted based on merit and available vacancies across the 26 banks listed above.

Why Was the Reserve List Released?

After the CRP RRBs-XIV final result, a primary list of selected candidates was allotted to participating rural banks. However, some sanctioned posts remained vacant because certain selected candidates did not join within the deadline, resigned soon after joining, or were excluded during document verification. To ensure these vacancies are filled, IBPS has released this reserve list for candidates who cleared the exam but were not allotted a bank in the first round.

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Click on the "IBPS RRB CRP-CSA (Customer Service Associate)" link on the homepage.
  3. Select "CRP-CRP XIV – Provisional Allotment under Reserve List for CRP-CRP XIV."
  4. Enter your Registration No/Roll No and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Enter the captcha code and click Login.
  6. Check your provisional allotment status and download it for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Candidates provisionally allotted from the reserve list will also receive an intimation email and SMS on their registered contact details.
  • The allotment shown after login is provisional and will be confirmed only after the concerned bank completes document and eligibility verification.
  • Specific documents required for verification are not listed in the official notification. Candidates should follow the instructions issued directly by their allotted bank.
  • Candidates should keep checking their registered email and SMS regularly to avoid missing further communication or deadlines.

What Happens After Reserve List Allotment?

Based on the notification, candidates allotted through the reserve list can expect the following process, though exact dates and requirements are not specified:

  • Document Verification
  • Submission of Required Certificates
  • Medical Examination (if applicable)
  • Joining Formalities
  • Induction/Training Process

Central Bank of India Apprentice Selection Process

The engagement process for Central Bank of India Apprentices FY 2026-27 involved the following stages, as per the official notification:

  1. Online application (as per notification dated 11.06.2026)

The Bank has clarified that merely qualifying the online test does not entitle a candidate to selection. The Bank reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates after preliminary screening.

The Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) has released the APSC Forest Ranger Admit Card 2026 on 24 August 2026 for candidates appearing in the Forest Ranger written examination under Advertisement No. 22/2025. Eligible candidates can now download their e-Admission Certificate through the APSC recruitment portal.

The APSC Forest Ranger written examination will be conducted on different dates from 30 August to 13 September 2026. Candidates appearing for the examination should download their admit card before the exam date and carefully check their exam date, reporting time, venue and other instructions.

APSC Forest Ranger Admit Card 2026 - Download Link

The APSC Forest Ranger Admit Card 2026 download facility is available through the Assam Public Service Commission recruitment portal. Candidates can access the e-Admission Certificate using the required details on the admit card download page.

APSC Forest Ranger Exam Date 2026

The APSC Forest Ranger written examination will begin on 30 August 2026 and continue on different dates until 13 September 2026. The examination consists of both Conventional Type and Objective Type (OMR) papers.

Candidates should appear only for the subjects applicable to them according to the official examination programme and the details mentioned on their e-Admission Certificate.

How to Download APSC Forest Ranger Admit Card 2026

Candidates can follow the steps given below to download the APSC Forest Ranger e-Admission Certificate 2026:

  1. Visit the Assam Public Service Commission official website at apsc.nic.in.
  2. Go to the admit card or e-Admission Certificate section.
  3. Find the link related to the Forest Ranger Examination under Advertisement No. 22/2025.
  4. Click on the Forest Ranger e-Admission Certificate download link.
  5. Enter the details required on the admit card portal.
  6. Submit the information to view the e-Admission Certificate.
  7. Check all the information displayed on the admit card.
  8. Download the APSC Forest Ranger Admit Card 2026.
  9. Take a clear printout and keep it safely for the examination.

Details Required to Download APSC Forest Ranger Hall Ticket

Candidates should keep their application-related details ready while accessing the APSC admit card portal. The APSC recruitment system provides the e-Admission Certificate download facility using candidate application details.

Candidates should enter the information exactly as submitted during the application process. If the entered details are incorrect, the admit card may not be displayed.

Details Mentioned on APSC Forest Ranger Admit Card 2026

After downloading the Forest Ranger e-Admission Certificate, candidates should carefully check all the information printed on it. Important details may include:

  • Candidate's name
  • Application or roll number
  • Forest Ranger examination details
  • Subject or paper details
  • Examination date
  • Examination time
  • Reporting time
  • Examination centre
  • Candidate instructions

If candidates notice any discrepancy in the details printed on the admit card, they should follow the instructions issued by APSC and contact the Commission through the appropriate official channel.

Documents Required for APSC Forest Ranger Exam 2026

Candidates appearing for the Forest Ranger written examination should carry the documents prescribed by APSC. Candidates should keep the following documents ready:

  • A clear printed copy of the APSC Forest Ranger e-Admission Certificate 2026
  • A valid photo identity proof as prescribed by the Commission

Candidates should also check the instructions printed on their e-Admission Certificate for any additional document requirements.

  • Carry the required valid photo identity proof to the examination centre.

This recruitment exam is being conducted for OT Technician posts under the Directorate of Health Services, Chhattisgarh. The exam is scheduled for 30 August 2026 (Sunday), and admit cards can be downloaded from 24 August 2026 onward. This article covers the exam date, admit card download steps, required documents, dress code, and other important instructions issued by CGSSB.

How to Download CGSSB OT Technician Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official website vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in or cgssb.cgstate.gov.in.
  2. Click on the admit card download link for OT Technician (HOTT26) exam, or go directly to the candidate login page at vyapamprofile.cgstate.gov.in/online.

  4. Download the complete admit card and take a printout.
  5. Print the admit card on one side of the page only, since a copy must be submitted at the exam center.

Also Read: APSC Forest Ranger Admit Card 2026

Documents Required at the Exam Center

  • Printed copy of the admit card (complete, one-sided printout)
  • Original photo ID proof any one of Voter ID Card, Driving License, PAN Card, or Aadhar Card
  • Note: Candidates will not be allowed entry into the exam center without the original photo ID proof mentioned on the admit card.

Exam Day Instructions and Dress Code

  • Candidates must report to the exam center at least 2 hours before the exam start time to allow for identity verification and frisking.
  • Candidates are advised to visit and familiarize themselves with the exam center location a day before the exam.
  • The main entry gate will close 30 minutes before the exam starts since the exam begins at 10:00 AM, the gate will close at 9:30 AM. No entry will be given after the time mentioned on the admit card.
  • Candidates must wear light-colored, half-sleeve clothing. Black, dark blue, dark green, purple, maroon, and dark chocolate-colored clothes are not allowed.
  • Candidates must wear slippers or sandals; shoes are not allowed as footwear.
  • Wearing any type of ear jewelry or ornaments is prohibited.
  • Candidates cannot leave the exam hall during the first 30 minutes and the last 30 minutes of the exam.
  • Communication devices, electronic devices, electronic watches, purses, pouches, scarves, belts, caps, and similar items are strictly prohibited inside the exam hall.
  • The admit card will be required at the time of selection/document verification, so candidates should keep it safe after the exam.
  • Candidates who fail to follow the instructions will be barred from taking the exam. Use of unfair means will lead to strict action and cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates wearing religious or cultural attire must report to the exam center earlier than the general reporting time, as they will need to undergo an additional security check.

How to Download IOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026?

  4. Check every detail on the admit card, including your name, roll number, exam date, reporting time, and exam-day instructions.
  5. Download and save the admit card on your device.

IOB Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online examination consists of 100 objective-type questions carrying 100 marks, to be completed in 90 minutes, across four sections:

IOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026: Important Instructions

  • Check the reporting time mentioned on your admit card and reach the reporting location (exam centre, or your home setup if the exam is confirmed as remote-proctored) well ahead of the scheduled time.
  • Do not carry mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, or any study material into the examination hall, if attending at a physical centre.
  • Ensure your photograph, signature, and other personal details on the admit card are clearly visible before exam day.
  • If the exam is remote-proctored, ensure a working device with a front camera, microphone, and stable internet connection, as per the instructions on your specific call letter.

What to Do in Case of an Issue in the IOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026?

If any discrepancy is found on the admit card, candidates should act promptly:

  1. Verify the name, date of birth, and category details carefully.
  2. Check whether the photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the exam date, time, and exam centre/mode details.
  4. Contact the helpdesk through the official support channels on iob.in or the BFSI SSC portal if any information is incorrect.
  5. Keep the application form and registration details ready while requesting corrections.
  6. Download the corrected IOB Apprentice Admit Card PDF once the issue is resolved.

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original government-issued photo ID proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence
  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

How to Download the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Follow these steps to download your Central Bank of India Apprentice hall ticket:

  1. Visit the official website of the Central Bank of India at centralbankofindia.co.in or centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the "CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026" or "Download Call Letter" link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code, if required.
  6. Click the Login or Submit button.

  8. Carefully verify all details, including your name, photograph, signature, exam date, and exam centre.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout on an A4 sheet for the examination.

The online written examination consists of 100 objective-type questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes, with no negative marking.

The Bank of Baroda Apprentice selection process does not end with the written exam. Candidates who qualify in the online test move to the following stages:

  1. Document Verification - Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents for eligibility verification.
  2. Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the official local language of the state they applied for.
  3. Medical Examination - A final medical fitness check is conducted before confirmation of selection.

Selected apprentices will be engaged for a one-year apprenticeship period and will receive a stipend of ₹15,000 per month during this engagement.

The National Informatics Centre (NIC), under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India, has released a detailed advertisement (Ref No. NIC/STA/2026/2) inviting online applications for the post of Scientific/Technical Assistant-A. This is a Group-B S&T (Non-Gazetted) post to be filled purely on the basis of a valid GATE score (2024, 2025, or 2026), with no written examination or interview involved. Online applications can be submitted from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026 through the official portal, recruitment.nic.in.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

NIC has published the detailed advertisement for the Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post on its official recruitment portal. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying online.

Advertisement No. NIC/STA/2026/2
Total Vacancies 376 (across 3 disciplines) - tentative

Cut-off Date for Eligibility 30.09.2026 (same as closing date)
Document Verification Schedule Will be announced on NIC website, www.recruitment.nic.in

The cut-off date for determining age, qualification, and category eligibility is the closing date (30 September 2026), and this will remain unchanged even if the application window is extended.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Vacancy 2026

NIC has advertised a total of 376 vacancies (computed from the discipline-wise figures given in the notification) for the Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post, spread across three disciplines: Computer Sciences & Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. The notification clarifies that the number of advertised posts is tentative and may increase or decrease at NIC's sole discretion.

S. No. Discipline No. of Posts
1 Computer Sciences & Information Technology 300 (UR-122, SC-45, ST-22, OBC(NCL)-81, EWS-30)

3 Data Science and Artificial Intelligence 50 (UR-22, SC-7, ST-3, OBC(NCL)-13, EWS-5)

In addition to the vertical reservation shown above, horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) is provided: 15 posts in Computer Sciences & IT (Locomotor disability-4, Hard of Hearing-4, Multiple Disabilities-7, including a 3-post PH-MD backlog vacancy within this figure), 2 posts each in Electronics & Communication Engineering and Data Science & AI (Locomotor disability-1, Hard of Hearing-1 in each discipline).

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for the post is assessed as on the closing date, 30 September 2026, and is based on both a valid GATE score and the prescribed educational qualification.

Valid GATE Score Requirement

Discipline GATE Paper Code
Computer Sciences and Information Technology CS
Electronics and Communication Engineering EC
Data Science and Artificial Intelligence DA

Candidates must possess a valid GATE score from 2024, 2025, or 2026 in the paper code corresponding to the discipline they are applying for.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Educational Qualification

  • Computer Sciences & Information Technology: A pass in M.Sc./MS/MCA/B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, Computer Sciences, Computer and Networking Security, Software System, Information Technology, or Informatics (single or in combination), along with a valid GATE score in Paper Code CS.
  • Electronics and Communication Engineering: Candidates must possess a valid GATE score in Paper Code EC. The notification does not separately detail the qualifying degree fields for this discipline beyond the GATE requirement.
  • Data Science and Artificial Intelligence: Candidates must possess a valid GATE score in Paper Code DA. The notification does not separately detail the qualifying degree fields for this discipline beyond the GATE requirement.

The candidate must have obtained the essential qualification on or before the closing date. No claim of a qualification equivalent to the prescribed qualification will be entertained. There is no experience requirement for this post.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Age Limit

The upper age limit is calculated as on the closing date, 30 September 2026.

Category Upper Age Limit
UR / EWS 30 years
SC / ST 35 years
OBC (NCL) 33 years
PwBD 40 years (SC/ST PwBD: 45 years; OBC(NCL) PwBD: 43 years)
Service Candidate UR/EWS: 35 years; SC/ST: 40 years; OBC(NCL): 38 years
Ex-servicemen As per Government Rules

An additional 5-year age relaxation applies to candidates serving in Government organizations in the same line or allied cadres, where their existing service is relevant to the advertised post. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applies only to posts reserved for them, whereas relaxation for PwBD candidates applies irrespective of reservation status, provided the post is identified as suitable for them.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Salary

The Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post carries a pay of Level 6 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, i.e., ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 per month, in addition to applicable allowances as per Government of India norms.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Application Fee

Category Application Fee
SC / ST / PwBD / Women candidates Nil
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS ₹800

Candidates applying for more than one discipline must pay ₹800 separately for each discipline applied for. The fee can be paid only through online mode (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking); Cash, Demand Draft, Pay Order, or Cheque will not be accepted. Bank charges towards remittance, if any, must be borne by the candidate. The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Selection Process

  • Only candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria and who have completed registration on the NIC portal will be considered for further selection.
  • A category-wise merit list will be prepared for each discipline based on GATE Score, with equal weightage given to GATE 2024, GATE 2025, and GATE 2026 scores.
  • Candidates must submit their best GATE score from any one of the eligible years for the discipline applied.
  • In case of a tie: (1) the older-year GATE score is ranked higher; (2) if the score and year are the same, the older candidate is ranked higher; (3) if still tied, the candidate with a higher percentage in the essential qualification is ranked higher.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification before being offered a provisional appointment.
  • Non-appearance for document verification with original documents will result in rejection of candidature.
  • Document verification will be conducted at Delhi or any other location/mode approved by the competent authority; no request for postponement or change of location will be entertained, and no TA/DA will be paid.

  • Scanned signature in blue or black ink (JPEG/JPG, 10 KB–50 KB)
  • Date of Birth proof (Municipality certificate or Matriculation/High School/SSC Certificate)

  • Valid GATE Score Card for 2024/2025/2026

  • Age relaxation certificate, if applicable
  • Aadhaar Card (for Aadhaar-based authentication)

All document PDFs must be self-attested scanned copies, sized between 10 KB and 500 KB each.

  1. Visit the official NIC recruitment portal at https://recruitment.nic.in.
  2. Complete Step 1: Registration using a valid email ID and active mobile number.
  3. Complete Step 2: Fill the online application form and upload all required documents.

East Coast Railway (ECoR) has released a Centralized Notification for the ECoR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026, inviting online applications for engagement as Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, against 1,599 training slots across 25 designated trades. The Railway Recruitment Cell, Bhubaneswar (RRC/BBS) is the nodal agency for this recruitment, covering Divisions and Workshops under ECoR's jurisdiction. Online applications can be submitted at www.rrcbbs.org.in from 26.08.2026 (5:00 PM) to 15.09.2026 (5:00 PM). The application fee is ₹100, with no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates, and there is no written test or interview - selection is based purely on Matriculation merit.

ECoR Act Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: Matriculation (10th Class) under the 10+2 system with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks from a recognized Board, held as on 21.08.2026 (the notification date).

Technical Qualification: An ITI certificate in the relevant trade, affiliated to NCVT/SCVT, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.

  • Applicants whose SSC or ITI results are awaited as on the notification date are not eligible
  • Applicants who have failed in ITI must not apply; if inadvertently engaged, the apprenticeship will be terminated immediately
  • Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible under this notification (they fall under a separate apprenticeship scheme)
  • For Laboratory Technician (Pathology): candidate must be 12th pass (10+2 system) with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, with a minimum of 50% marks in both 10th and 12th
  • For Secretarial Assistant (Stenography): candidate must hold a National Trade Certificate (NTC) approved by NCVT/SCVT
  • For Computer Operator & Programming Assistant: candidate must have board-based basic training in the IT sector under the Centre of Excellence scheme (hardware/networking repair and maintenance), with an NTC approved by NCVT/SCVT

Applicants possessing ITI qualifications in more than one trade may apply separately for each relevant trade. Applicants can choose only one Division/Workshop, and this choice is final and binding.

ECoR Act Apprentice Age Limit

Age is reckoned as on the closing date, 15.09.2026.

  • General age limit: 15 to 24 years
  • SC/ST candidates: upper age limit relaxed by 5 years
  • OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by 3 years
  • PwBD candidates: upper age limit relaxed by 10 years
  • Ex-Servicemen: 10 additional years to the extent of Defence service rendered, plus 3 years, provided a minimum of 6 months of service at a stretch (applicable to the Ex-Serviceman applicant personally, not to their children)
  • Children of deceased/disabled Ex-Servicemen, children of Ex-Servicemen, children of serving Jawans, and children of serving Officers are also considered for engagement under specified categories, with the same age relaxation as per their community

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

Fee must be paid online only, through the payment gateway integrated with the application process (Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI/Internet Banking). Transaction charges, if any, are borne by the applicant.

ECoR Act Apprentice Stipend

Selected candidates will be paid a monthly stipend at the prescribed rate during the training period, as per extant rules and directives issued by the Railway Board from time to time. The notification does not specify an exact stipend amount. No hostel accommodation is provided during training - apprentices must make their own arrangements.

ECoR Act Apprentice Selection Process

  • Selection is based solely on a merit list prepared from the percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) - there is no written test or interview
  • The percentage is calculated using marks from all subjects (not the "best of five" approach); candidates with a CGPA must convert it to the equivalent percentage
  • In case of tied marks, preference goes to the older candidate; if dates of birth are also identical, whoever passed Matriculation earlier is prioritized
  • A trade-wise and community-wise merit list is prepared; candidates are called for Document Verification (DV) at ECoR Headquarters, Bhubaneswar, based on merit in their preferred trade
  • Candidates are shortlisted strictly by academic merit and the order of preference of Unit–Department–Trade exercised in their application; a candidate is considered for only one combination, and once selected against a higher preference, all lower preferences are automatically cancelled
  • Final selection is subject to verification of original documents and submission of a Medical Fitness Certificate
  • Standby-list candidates are issued call letters only upon receipt of details of absentee/unfit/rejected candidates, strictly in order of merit
  • No TA/DA is paid to candidates called for Document Verification
  • Candidates who completed apprenticeship training (CCAA) and hold a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) get preference for up to 20% of Level-1 direct-recruitment vacancies in future, subject to RRB/RRC eligibility criteria - this is a separate benefit, not part of this apprentice selection itself

Documents Required for ECoR Act Apprentice Recruitment

  • Mark sheet and Pass Certificate of Matriculation (Class X) or equivalent
  • Proof of date of birth, if not mentioned in the Matriculation certificate
  • Consolidated ITI mark sheet for all semesters of the relevant trade, or Provisional National Trade Certificate
  • National Trade Certificate (NCVT) or Provisional Trade Certificate (NCVT/SCVT)
  • Caste Certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates (OBC requires Non-Creamy-Layer certificate valid for 2026–27, issued on or after 01.04.2026, plus a self-declaration)
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates (family gross annual income below ₹8 lakh, and specified asset limits not exceeded)
  • Disability Certificate for PwBD candidates
  • Discharge Certificate/Serving Certificate for Ex-Servicemen quota candidates
  • Scanned photograph (3.5cm × 3.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–70 KB) and signature (3.5cm × 3.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20–30 KB)
  • Aadhaar Card (12-digit number, or 28-digit Enrolment ID if the card is not yet received)

How to Apply for ECoR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website, www.rrcbbs.org.in
  2. Register and then log in to the portal
  3. Fill in personal details, trade, Aadhaar number, marks/CGPA, and choice of Division/Workshop carefully (only one Division/Workshop can be selected, and it is final)
  4. Upload the scanned photograph, signature, and all required documents/certificates
  5. Pay the application fee of ₹100 online (not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women), via the integrated payment gateway
  6. Take a printout of the submitted application for your records

A candidate is allowed to submit only one application; multiple applications for the same trade with different particulars will be summarily rejected. No hard copies of the application or documents are to be sent by post.

ECoR Act Apprentice Important Instructions

  • Applicants must not change their registered mobile number or email ID during the entire selection process
  • Name, father's name, and date of birth must exactly match the Matriculation certificate; any discrepancy found during Document Verification may lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Requests for change of Trade, Division, or Workshop after selection will not be entertained
  • Candidates found ineligible or erroneously engaged shall have their apprenticeship terminated without prior notice at any stage
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification
  • RRC/BBS has not appointed any agents; applicants are cautioned against touts and job racketeers
  • Any legal matter arising from this notification falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT), Cuttack
  • Apprentices trained under this scheme have no claim to employment with the Railways after completion of training

IndianOil Corporation Limited (IOCL), Marketing Division, has released Advertisement No. IOCL/MKTG/NR/APPR/2026-27/1 for the engagement of Technician, Graduate, and Trade Apprentices (Technical and Non-Technical) under the Apprentices Act, 1961, at locations across its Northern Region. A total of 433 apprentice seats are available across Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand, spanning 14 discipline codes covering Technician, ITI Trade, Graduate, and Data Entry Operator apprenticeships. Candidates holding a Class X pass with relevant ITI trade certification, a recognised Diploma in Engineering, or a graduate degree in any discipline can apply online through the NAPS or NATS portal, as applicable, between 07 August 2026 (10:00 AM) and 06 September 2026 (5:00 PM). Selection is purely merit-based on qualifying marks, with no written test or interview.

Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Where CGPA/OGPA/Letter Grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be indicated in the online application as per the norms of the concerned Board/University/Institute, with a supporting certificate furnished at document verification.
  • A candidate may undergo a maximum of two apprenticeship trainings, and the second must be in a different trade, with a minimum one-year gap between the two (subject to conditions specified in the notification for terminated contracts).
  • Candidates applying under NATS or NAPS who have completed five years in the relevant discipline (as on 31.08.2026) after acquiring the prescribed qualification are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E., MBA, MCA, CA, ICWA, LLB, or equivalent (completed on or before joining) are NOT eligible.
  • Diploma or Vocational Certificate holders with one year or more of job experience after acquiring the qualification are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates whose apprenticeship contract has already been approved by BOAT on the NATS portal cannot create a second apprenticeship contract, even if the earlier one is later terminated.
  • Candidates can apply for ONLY ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to summary rejection of all applications.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend

The stipend payable to apprentices is governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961, the Apprentices Rules, 1992, and applicable amendments/guidelines. In addition to the statutory stipend, IOCL (MD), NR will pay ₹2,500 per month towards miscellaneous expenses. For Graduate and Technician Apprentices, a portion of the stipend is disbursed directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the apprentice's Aadhaar-seeded bank account by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT). Trade Apprentices (NAPS apprentices) receive their full stipend directly from IOCL (MD), NR. These arrangements are subject to change as per government/BOAT/NAPS guidelines issued from time to time. A specific fixed monthly stipend amount is not stated in the official notification.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  1. Online Application: Candidates registered on the NAPS/NATS portal and applying against the notification are considered for selection. There is no written test or interview.
  2. Merit List: Prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed qualification for the respective post. Ties are resolved first by earlier date of birth, and then by higher marks in matriculation if the date of birth is also the same.
  3. Preference: Given to candidates applying for apprenticeship training for the first time.
  4. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification.
  5. Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Test: Candidates must be adjudged medically fit as per IOCL's pre-engagement medical standards.
  6. Offer of Engagement: Issued to candidates who successfully clear document verification and the medical fitness test. Up to ₹3,000 is reimbursed towards expenses incurred for pre-engagement medical tests/investigations, on production of receipts.

Also read: Bank of Baroda Professionals Recruitment 2026 Notification Out

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

The following original documents, along with self-attested copies, must be furnished at document verification:

  • Matriculation (Class X) mark sheet/certificate issued by the Board of Secondary Education - the only acceptable proof of date of birth.
  • Latest caste certificate (for reserved category candidates) in the Government-prescribed proforma, issued by a competent authority.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, issued on or after 01.09.2025 (not more than 12 months old as on 31.08.2026), for candidates claiming OBC-NCL reservation.
  • Certificate from the institute confirming the candidate pursued the course through regular mode, with the year of passing.
  • Semester-wise/year-wise mark sheets of ITI (NCVT/SCVT)/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering, as applicable.
  • Final ITI (NCVT/SCVT) Certificate/HSC/Graduation/Diploma in Engineering certificate issued by the respective Board/Authority/Institute.
  • Copy of the first page of the bank passbook of the Aadhaar-seeded account, Aadhaar card, PAN card, and a cancelled cheque leaf.
  • Pre-engagement medical fitness certificate.

How to Apply for IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Register as a Graduate/Technician/Trade Apprentice on the applicable portal for your state:
    • Trade Apprentice (ITI): NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Trade Apprentice-Data Entry Operator: NAPS portal - apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
    • Technician Apprentice (Diploma): NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in
    • Graduate Apprentice: NATS portal - nats.education.gov.in
  2. Ensure your profile (personal details, educational details, category, aggregate percentage) is complete and correct before applying; corrections must be made through the NAPS/NATS office.
  3. Log in to the respective NATS/NAPS portal and apply for the opportunity using IOCL (MD)-Northern Region's Establishment ID: NATS – NDLSDC000005; NAPS – E05200700003.
  4. After applying on the NAPS/NATS portal, also submit your details, preferred state, and three preferred locations via the Microsoft Office Form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c
  5. Both the NAPS/NATS application and the Microsoft Office Form must be completed by 06 September 2026, 5:00 PM. Only one Microsoft Form response is allowed - multiple submissions will not be entertained.
  6. Apply for only ONE discipline code; applying for more than one will lead to rejection of the application.

IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates must have a valid, active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on NAPS/NATS, and 100% completion of their profile.
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least 1 year, as all communication regarding document verification/engagement will be sent only via email/SMS.
  • Candidates must possess a PAN card, an Aadhaar card, and an active bank account with a cheque book (same account as updated on the NATS portal), seeded to Aadhaar and enabled for DBT, along with an updated APAAR ID and e-KYC verification on the NATS portal.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats will be considered only if they meet the standards applicable to General category candidates.
  • Candidates registered with a Local/State Employment Exchange/Vocational Rehabilitation Centre for PwBD must apply only through the NAPS/NATS portal.
  • The apprenticeship period is 12 months for all disciplines. On completion, IOCL has no obligation to offer regular employment, and apprentices cannot claim employment rights on the grounds of completing the apprenticeship. Ex-apprentices get an equal opportunity to apply for future openings like any other candidate.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to verification; any false/incorrect/suppressed information detected at any stage - even after engagement - can lead to cancellation or termination.
  • Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per Corporation requirements and all relevant rules/policies/guidelines.
  • The decision of the management is final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, selection, and cancellation of the process; filling of seats is entirely at the discretion of management, and no claim will arise if seats remain unfilled.
  • Incomplete applications, applications in any other mode, or those received after the last date will be treated as rejected. Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate.

Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited (RFCL) - a Joint Venture Company formed by National Fertilizers Limited (NFL), Engineers India Limited (EIL), and Fertilizer Corporation of India Limited (FCIL), operating a 2200 MT/day natural gas-based Ammonia and 3850 MT/day Neem Coated Urea Plant at Ramagundam, Telangana - has released Advertisement No. Rectt/01/2026 (dated 26 August 2026) for the Recruitment of Experienced Professionals. RFCL invites applications for 40 vacancies across 15 post-and-level combinations spanning Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Materials, Transportation, Human Resource, Medical, Finance & Accounts, and Information Technology disciplines, for postings at its Ramagundam Plant (Telangana) and Corporate Office (Noida).

RFCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria & Qualification

Key Eligibility Conditions

  • No claim of an equivalent educational qualification other than what is advertised for a post will be entertained; RFCL's decision on admissibility of a qualification is final and binding.
  • The essential qualification must be completed full-time and regular with a minimum of 60% marks, except for CA/CMA. Qualifications acquired through Part-Time/Correspondence/Distance Learning/Online/Evening Classes render the candidate ineligible.
  • Candidates appearing in the final year/semester of the essential qualification, with results awaited as on the cut-off date, are NOT eligible to apply.
  • Work experience for all posts must be after acquiring the relevant educational qualification, and must be in-line executive experience. Management Trainee/GET experience counts only if regularized in the same company. Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 does not count as post-qualification experience. Experience with candidates working on contract basis through empaneled agencies/contractors will not be considered.
  • Candidates possessing higher technical/professional qualifications in the relevant field are also eligible, provided they possess the mandatory qualification listed above.
  • Where CGPA/OGPA or a letter grade is awarded instead of a percentage, candidates must produce the University/Institute's official conversion formula; in its absence, a standard conversion table is used (e.g., 6.5 on a 10-point scale = 60%).
  • Computer literacy is desirable for all candidates.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview, or submit an undertaking to produce a relieving order if selected - failing which they will not be allowed to join; no Service Transfer/Pay Protection will apply without an NOC at joining.
  • Preference will be given to candidates with in-line executive experience in the Chemical and Fertilizer Industry.

Pay-Scale / CTC Matching Condition for Experience

Candidates from Government/PSU/Autonomous/Statutory Bodies/JVs with Pay Scales matching RFCL's scales should presently be working one level below the applicable pay scale for at least 1 year (E-1 posts) or 2 years (E-2 and above posts) immediately preceding the cut-off date, or be presently working in the same or higher pay scale on the cut-off date (see Annexure-A pay-scale correspondence table in the official notification). Candidates from the Private Sector, or from Government/PSU bodies whose pay scales do not match RFCL's, must provide proof of a minimum CTC as on the cut-off date, as detailed in the Salary section below.

RFCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of applications will be done based on the information and documents submitted; eligible candidates will be provisionally shortlisted and called for a Personal Interview. The shortlist will be placed on the RFCL website under "Careers."
  • If a large number of applications are received, RFCL may conduct a Computer-Based Test in Delhi-NCR and/or other cities for shortlisting candidates for interview. No TA, or Boarding & Lodging, will be paid/arranged for appearing in this test. Test modalities, if conducted, will be published on the RFCL website.
  • Candidates must qualify the Personal Interview with a minimum average of 50% marks.
  • Tie-breaker for equal total marks: percentage of marks in the qualifying examination; if still equal, the candidate with the earlier date of birth is considered senior in the merit list.
  • Candidates not meeting eligibility criteria, or without complete requisite documents, will not be allowed to attend the interview, and no TA will be paid.
  • Travel Reimbursement for Interview: Candidates called for interview at level E-5 to E-8 are reimbursed single return air fare (economy class)/AC I rail fare/Executive class chair car/road mileage at prescribed rates. Candidates for E-1 to E-4 posts are reimbursed to-and-fro single AC II return rail fare from the nearest railway station of their correspondence address to the interview venue, by the shortest route, on production of documents/receipts.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of Degree certificates/testimonials, Caste/PwBD/ExSM status. Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage if the candidate does not meet the advertised eligibility criteria, irrespective of merit position.
  • No candidate will be appointed unless medically examined, certified, and declared fit for employment by the Company's Medical Officer or a Medical Officer not below the rank of Civil Surgeon/CMO/Medical Superintendent of a State/Government Hospital.

How to Apply for RFCL Recruitment 2026

  1. Eligible and interested candidates should apply online from 26 August 2026 (08:00 hrs) to 24 September 2026 (17:00 hrs) on the RFCL website: www.rfcl.co.in → Careers.
  2. Only one application per candidate per post is allowed. Details can be edited before final submission, but cannot be changed once the online form is finally submitted - fill in carefully.
  3. After successful online submission, take a printout of the application form.
  4. Send the printed application, along with self-attested copies of all requisite supporting documents (educational qualifications, experience certificates, caste certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.), in a sealed envelope superscribed:
    "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF …………………………… IN RFCL - 01/2026"
  5. Post the sealed envelope to:
    Dy. General Manager (HR), Ramagundam Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited, Corporate Office, 4th Floor, Wing – A, Kribhco Bhawan, Sector-1, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301
  6. Ensure the hard copy reaches RFCL by 1 October 2026 (or 8 October 2026 for candidates from notified far-flung areas, with "FAR-FLUNG AREA" superscribed on the envelope).

Incomplete application forms, forms not supported by self-attested documents, forms not fulfilling eligibility criteria, forms received at any other RFCL address, or forms received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

RFCL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • 10th/Matriculation certificate is the authentic document for verifying date of birth.
  • Details submitted in the online application (including correspondence address, email, mobile number, and category) are final; no change request will be entertained after submission.
  • Category (Gen/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD) once submitted cannot be changed, and no benefit of a different category will be admissible later.
  • Reserved category candidates must submit a copy of their Caste/PwBD certificate (in the Government-prescribed proforma, issued by a Competent Authority) along with the online application form; a self-certified translated copy is required if the original is not in English/Hindi.
  • Only OBC communities in the Central Government's common OBC list are treated as OBC; OBC(NCL) candidates must submit the latest Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the prescribed proforma and give a self-declaration at the interview. OBC candidates in the creamy layer are treated as Unreserved.
  • PwBD reservation is applied on a horizontal inter-locking basis; PwBD candidates are considered only against identified positions and must submit a Disability Certificate (as per the Persons with Disabilities Amended Rules, 2009) - a "person with benchmark disability" per Section 2(r) of the RPwD Act, 2016 must have not less than 40% disability.
  • Mere possession of the essential qualification does not entitle a candidate to participate in the selection process; RFCL's decision on eligibility, shortlisting, and selection is final and binding.
  • Shortlisted candidates must bring original certificates at the interview; failing this, they may not be allowed to appear, and no TA will be paid.
  • Furnishing false/incorrect/incomplete information, suppressing material facts, using unfair means, or impersonation renders a candidate ineligible; candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated at any stage, even during employment.
  • Candidates should keep their registered email ID and mobile number active for at least 1.5 years from the cut-off date, as all communication will be via email/SMS/website upload; no change of email ID is allowed once submitted.
  • Retain a copy of the Application Form and Fee receipt for future reference.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum/errata will be published only on the RFCL website (www.rfcl.co.in → Careers); no further press advertisement will be issued.
  • Issues related to form fill-up or fee payment may be emailed to: [email protected]
  • In case of any ambiguity in versions other than English, the English version on the RFCL website shall prevail.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The court of jurisdiction for any dispute arising from this recruitment process is New Delhi only, to the exclusion of all other courts.

(RVUN), on behalf of the Common Recruitment Exercise of the five State Power Companies of Rajasthan - RVUN, RVPN, JVVN, AVVN and JdVVN - has invited online applications for 2,005 vacancies across three posts: Junior Engineer-I (Electrical/Mechanical/Civil), Junior Accountant, and Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II. This follows short Advertisement No. RVUN/Rectt.-2026-27/01, published in newspapers on 25 June 2026, and two detailed advertisements - RVUN/Rectt.-2026-27/02 (Junior Engineer-I) and RVUN/Rectt.-2026-27/03 (Junior Accountant and Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II) - both dated 4 August 2026. Online applications open on 5 August 2026 at 10:00 AM and close on 31 August 2026 at midnight, to be submitted only through the official energy.rajasthan.gov.in portal and its Nigam-specific sub-portals.

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Qualification

Post Educational Qualification (as on date fixed for Documents Verification)
Junior Engineer-I (Electrical) Full-Time 4-year Graduation Degree in Engineering (regular student) or AMIE in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electrical, Instrumentation & Control/Power Systems & High Voltage/Power Electronics/Power Engineering or equivalent, from a University/Institution established by law in India and recognized equivalent by AICTE
Junior Engineer-I (Mechanical) Full-Time 4-year Graduation Degree in Engineering (regular student) or AMIE in Mechanical/Production/Industrial Engineering/Production & Industrial/Thermal/Mechanical & Automation/Power Engineering or equivalent, AICTE-recognized
Junior Engineer-I (Civil) Full-Time 4-year Graduation Degree in Engineering (regular student) or AMIE in Structural/Civil Construction/Civil Engineering or equivalent, AICTE-recognized
Junior Accountant Graduation Degree in Commerce or Business Administration from a recognized University; OR Intermediate exam of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India, Kolkata, or IPCC/Intermediate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, New Delhi; OR MBA (or equivalent, including a 2-year PG Diploma in Business Management declared equivalent to MBA); OR M.Com of minimum 2 years - PLUS a recognized computer qualification (see note below)
Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II Senior Secondary Examination (12th) from a recognized Board or equivalent - PLUS a recognized computer qualification (see note below)

Computer qualification (for Junior Accountant and Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II): Any one of - "O" or Higher Level Certificate Course by DOEACC; NIELIT Certificate course on Computer Concepts; COPA/DPCS certificate under the National/State Council of Vocational Training Scheme; a Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer Application; Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Application as a subject; a computer-related subject in one semester/year of a Bachelor's Degree or higher qualification/CA(ITT)/ICWA/CS/MBA; Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering from a recognized polytechnic; or the Rajasthan State Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT). Candidates for both posts must also have working knowledge of Hindi in Devnagri script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture; Junior Engineer-I candidates have the same Hindi/Rajasthani-culture requirement.

Candidates appearing in the final year/semester of the required qualification may also apply, but must submit proof of having acquired the qualification (including computer qualification, if prescribed) by the date fixed for Documents Verification; failure to do so results in automatic rejection even if the candidate clears the exam. For Ex-servicemen, computer qualification is not mandatory at the application stage but must be acquired before joining if selected; a minimum 3-month certificate course from a Defence Institution of the Government of India is also accepted as computer qualification.

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Post Age Limit
Junior Accountant / Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II 18–40 years (general rule); as direct recruitment was not conducted in the previous 3 years, the upper age limit as on 01-01-2027 is relaxed to 43 years
Junior Engineer-I (Electrical) - RVUN, JVVN, AVVN, JdVVN 21–40 years
Junior Engineer-I (Electrical) - RVPN 21 years to 43 years
Junior Engineer-I (Mechanical) - RVUN 21–40 years
Junior Engineer-I (Civil) - RVPN 21 years to 43 years

Age is reckoned as on 1 January next following the last date fixed for online submission of application, i.e. 01-01-2027. Upper age relaxation: 5 years for male SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS candidates; 5 years for women in the Unreserved category; 10 years for women in SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS categories; an additional 5 years for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), on top of category relaxation. Ex-servicemen relaxation differs by post: for Junior Accountant/Junior Assistant, it is equal to the length of military service plus 3 years (capped so the resulting age does not exceed 50 years); for Junior Engineer-I, it is a flat 15 years (similarly capped at 50 years). There is no upper age limit for in-service candidates of the same Nigam (applying to that Nigam only), for widows and divorced women, or for persons repatriated from Pakistan during the 1971 Indo-Pak War. Age relaxation is generally non-cumulative (one provision only), except in the case of PwBD, where it is added on top of category relaxation.

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Reservation

Reservation for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS/TSP/Saharias/PWBD(PH)/Ex-servicemen/Outstanding Sports Person (Junior Accountant and Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II only)/In-Service Nigam employees is as per the relevant Service Regulations. Reservation for women (including widows and divorcees), PWBD, In-Service employees, Outstanding Sports Persons and Ex-servicemen is horizontal - selected candidates are adjusted within their own social category. EWS candidates must be bonafide residents of Rajasthan not covered under SC/ST/BC/MBC reservation, with family gross annual income below Rs.8 lakh. Transgender candidates are considered under the OBC category (per GoR Personnel Department letter dated 26-05-2023), unless already covered under SC/ST/MBC/EWS with the relevant certificate, in which case that category's benefits apply.

Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are eligible only for specific disability types notified against each post (Visual Impairment, Hearing Impairment, Locomotor Disability, Intellectual & Mental Behaviour, and Multiple Disability, with post-specific sub-categories) - full detail is in the official advertisement's PWBD eligibility table. Candidates applying under the PWBD category must undergo verification by a Medical Board constituted by the Rajasthan Medical Department at the Divisional Headquarters, regardless of any disability certificate already held.

Creamy-layer BC/MBC candidates, and SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS candidates from states other than Rajasthan, are treated as UR (General) and must pay Rs.1,000/-.

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Salary

Selected candidates are initially engaged as "Probationer Trainee" for 2 years, drawing a fixed monthly remuneration during this period. On successful completion of probation, pay is fixed at the minimum of the applicable Level in the Pay Matrix as Basic Pay, plus allowances and other benefits as per relevant rules.

Post Pay Level Minimum Basic Pay (post-probation) Fixed Remuneration during Probation Training
