Junior Accountant Level-10 Rs.33,800/- p.m. Rs.23,700/- p.m.
Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II Level-5 Rs.20,800/- p.m. Rs.14,600/- p.m.

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Junior Engineer-I & Junior Accountant

Selection is through a single Computer-Based common written competitive exam (Online mode), of 2 hours' duration, consisting only of Objective Type (MCQ) questions, with negative marking for wrong answers and no interview.

  • Part A (60% weightage): For Junior Engineer-I, this is at Degree-in-Engineering level in the candidate's discipline. For Junior Accountant, this covers Corporate Accounting, Income Tax, Cost Accounting, Theory & Practice of Auditing, and Management Accounting/Advanced Cost Accounting/Cost & Management Audit/Computer Application in Accounting/Taxation Law & Practice/Advanced Financial Accounting, at Graduation Degree level.
  • Part B (40% weightage): Reasoning & Mental Ability; Mathematics (Class-XII level for JE-I, Class-X level for Junior Accountant); General Knowledge & Everyday Science (with special reference to Rajasthan); Hindi General (Class-X level); English General (Class-X level).

Minimum qualifying marks: 30% for UR candidates, 20% for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen/PWBD(PH) candidates, in each part.

Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II

Selection is in two phases, with no interview:

  • Phase-I (Computer Based Test): Stage-1 Pre-examination (screening only, no weightage in final merit) followed by Stage-2 Main-examination. Both are Objective/MCQ, covering Reasoning & Mental Ability, Mathematics (Class-X level), General Knowledge & Everyday Science, Hindi General (Class-X level) and English General (Class-X level). About 10 times the number of vacancies are admitted to the Main-examination from the Pre-examination merit list (with relaxed standards applied for reserved categories where needed to ensure adequate representation).
  • Phase-II (Type Writing Test): For candidates other than PWBD - Hindi typing on computer (Speed Test: 10 minutes/25 marks; Efficiency Test: 10 minutes/25 marks) and English typing on computer (Speed Test: 10 minutes/25 marks; Efficiency Test: 10 minutes/25 marks). PWBD candidates are instead given the average marks obtained in the Main-examination of Phase-I in place of the Type Writing Test.

Final merit is based on 40% weightage to Main-examination marks and 60% weightage to Phase-II (Type Writing Test) marks. There is no negative marking in the Pre-examination, but there is negative marking in the Main-examination. Minimum qualifying marks: 30% for UR, 20% for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen/PWBD(PH) candidates.

For all three posts, if two or more candidates secure equal marks, the elder candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher in the merit list; for Junior Engineer-I, candidates who completed apprenticeship training in a Vidyut Nigam under the Apprentices Act, 1961 are given preference within that Nigam in case of a tie.

How to Apply for RVUN Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

Applications must be submitted online only, through one of the official websites, between 5 August 2026 (10:00 AM) and 31 August 2026 (Midnight). No other mode of application is accepted.

  1. Visit any of the official websites: energy.rajasthan.gov.in, or the Nigam-specific portals (rrvun, rrvpn, jvvnl, jdvvnl, avvnl).
  2. Click "APPLY ONLINE," then "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter your Name, Contact details and Email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by email/SMS).
  3. Fill the application form, using "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress; carefully verify all details, as no change is possible after clicking "FINAL SUBMIT."
  4. Upload scanned Photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm), Signature (black ink, not in capital letters), Left Thumb Impression, and a Hand Written Declaration (in English, in the candidate's own handwriting) as per the specifications in the official advertisement. A Live Photograph must also be captured via webcam or mobile phone.
  5. Indicate your preference of Companies (RVUN/RVPN/JVVN/AVVN/JdVVN) - this preference is final and irrevocable, with no second opportunity for change.
  6. Preview the application, click "FINAL SUBMIT," then proceed to the "Payment" tab and pay the applicable fee online.
  7. Take a printout of the E-Receipt and the submitted Online Application Form for future reference - these are required at the time of Documents Verification.

A candidate may apply for more than one different post, but not submit multiple applications for the same post (only the latest valid application is retained in case of duplication, and fees paid for earlier attempts are forfeited).

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Documents Verification

Successful candidates, limited to about 2 times the vacancies in each category for each post/discipline, will be called for Documents Verification in order of merit. Candidates must bring original documents along with two self-attested photocopies, including (among others): the system-generated application printout, E-Receipt of fee, Degree/Provisional Degree or Institute Certificate, all mark-sheets, Senior Secondary/Secondary certificates (for date of birth), category certificates (SC/ST/EWS/BC/MBC, as applicable, issued by a Rajasthan competent authority only), PWBD medical certificate (if applicable), marriage/divorce/widowhood documents (if applicable), an affidavit regarding number of children, a Bonafide Resident Certificate, a character certificate, an affidavit regarding pending/past criminal cases, and an Employment Certificate or NOC if already employed in government service. Failure to appear for verification on the scheduled date leads to automatic rejection of candidature.

RVUN Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates must ensure their eligibility under all criteria before applying; permission to appear at any stage is purely provisional, subject to detailed verification of documents later.
  • Candidature found to be based on incomplete, incorrect or false information, or suppression of material facts, is liable to be rejected at any stage - even after joining service.
  • Selected candidates must furnish a Bond and Surety as per Regulations, and are subject to all terms and conditions applicable to a Probationer Trainee.
  • Candidates should regularly check the official websites and their registered email for recruitment updates; no information will be sent by post or any other mode.
  • RVUN reserves the right to cancel, restrict, modify or alter the recruitment process at any time, without notice.
  • The decision of RVUN in all matters relating to recruitment and selection is final and binding; no correspondence or personal enquiries will be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate. Use of unfair means, impersonation, or misconduct during the exam/verification process can lead to disqualification, debarment from future exams, and/or termination of service, in addition to liability for criminal prosecution under the Rajasthan Public Examination (Measures for Prevention of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act, 2022 and the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute regarding this recruitment lies with Jaipur.

Senior Software Engineers – Programmers/Developers Manager Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, ECE, EEE, Software Engineering, AI & ML, MCA or related 5 years
Senior Software Engineer – Testing & QA Manager Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, ECE, EEE, Software Engineering, AI & ML, MCA or related 5 years
Software Engineer – Data Analyst with AI/ML Modelling Manager Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, ECE, EEE, Software Engineering, AI & ML, AI & DS, MCA or related 5 years
IT Infrastructure – Server Administrators Assistant Manager B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent 2 years as Server/System Admin
IT Infrastructure – Network & Security Administrators Assistant Manager B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent 2 years as Network Admin
IT Infrastructure – Cloud Administrators Assistant Manager B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent 2 years as Cloud Admin
Software Engineer – Programmers/Developers Assistant Manager Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, ECE, EEE, Software Engineering, AI & ML, MCA or related 2 years

Oracle HCM (Payroll & Integrations / Talent, Workflow & Experience) Assistant Manager Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, ECE, MCA or related; Oracle University training desirable 2 years in Oracle Fusion HCM

Post-wise Key Skills and Responsibilities

Head Analytics & AI (DVP): Lead the bank's data-driven transformation; AI/ML and generative AI frameworks; Vector Databases & RAG Systems; SAS Viya, IBM CP4D, R, Python; model evaluation and explainability.

IT Infrastructure – Lead Systems/Servers (AVP): Server maintenance, storage, database management, Active Directory; VMware/OpenShift/Kubernetes; RHCSA/MCP/VCTA/Nutanix certifications preferred.

Data Scientist/Statistician (AVP): Enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions, predictive modelling, AI/ML platforms and MLOps, stakeholder management.

IT Infrastructure – Data Center Manager: 24/7/365 data center availability, security protocols, regulatory compliance; CDCP/RHCSA/VCTA/Nutanix certifications preferred.

Senior Software Engineer (Data Science, Statistics & ML): Python, SQL, R, Spark/PySpark, cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), Power BI/Tableau; credit risk, fraud and customer analytics.

Senior Software Engineers – Programmers/Developers: Java, .NET, Python; REST APIs; Git-based SDLC; CI/CD and DevOps practices.

Senior Software Engineer – Testing & QA: Functional, regression, SIT, UAT, automation testing; Jira, ALM/Zephyr/TestRail, Postman/REST Assured.

Software Engineer – Data Analyst with AI/ML Modelling: EDA, predictive analytics, classification/regression models, NLP (desirable), model deployment and monitoring.

IT Infrastructure – Server Administrators: Windows Server/Linux (RHEL) administration, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), Active Directory, security hardening.

IT Infrastructure – Network & Security Administrators: LAN/WAN/wireless administration, firewalls, DR/business continuity planning; CISSP/CISM/CEH preferred.

IT Infrastructure – Cloud Administrators: AWS/Azure/GCP infrastructure management, IAM, CI/CD, cost optimization; AWS SysOps/Azure Administrator certifications preferred.

Software Engineer – Programmers/Developers: Java (Spring Boot)/C#.NET, Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, SQL; React/Angular, Docker, Kubernetes desirable.

Software Engineer – Oracle Fusion: Oracle Fusion, VMS/CX modules, OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, OTBI/BI Publisher.

Oracle HCM (Payroll & Integrations / Talent, Workflow & Experience): Oracle Fusion HCM, Talent Management, Oracle Journeys, Workflow, HDL, HCM Extracts.

TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Age Limit

  • Head Analytics & AI (DVP): 45 years (as on 31.07.2026)
  • IT Infrastructure – Lead Systems/Servers (AVP): 45 years
  • Data Scientist/Statistician (AVP): 45 years
  • Data Center Manager, Senior Software Engineer roles, Software Engineer – Data Analyst (Manager cadre): 32 years
  • Server Administrators, Network & Security Administrators, Cloud Administrators, Software Engineer – Programmers/Developers, Software Engineer – Oracle Fusion, Oracle HCM roles (Assistant Manager cadre): 28 years

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Salary

The pay scale/salary structure for the Specialist Officer (IT) posts has not been specified in the notification. Compensation will likely be commensurate with the respective cadre (Deputy Vice President, Assistant Vice President, Manager, or Assistant Manager) as per Bank norms, but exact figures are not disclosed in the advertisement.

TMB Specialist Officer (IT) General Conditions

Condition Details
Posting Location Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Canvassing Any form of canvassing will lead to disqualification
Application Deadline Online application must be submitted on or before 06.09.2026

These general conditions apply uniformly across all 14 Specialist Officer (IT) posts advertised in this notification.

TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Application Fee

There is no application fee for the TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026. The notification explicitly states "Application Fee: Nil" for all posts.

TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of candidates based on the online application submitted.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Personal Interview through Direct mode or Video Conferencing.
  • The mode, date, and time of the interview will be communicated individually to eligible candidates.
  • The Bank's decision on eligibility, interview, and selection will be final.

TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Documents Required

  • Self-attested photo copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate (for age proof)
  • Self-attested photo copy of Degree Certificate(s)
  • Experience certificate(s) and Relieving Letter
  • Last Month Salary Slip
  • Scanned photograph (390 x 520 pixels, max 120 KB)
  • Scanned signature, not in capital letters (240 x 240 pixels, max 60 KB)

How to Apply for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Bank's official website at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/ and download the detailed advertisement to confirm eligibility.
  2. Click "Apply Online" and register for the post of "Specialist Officer (I.T)" using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
  3. On successful registration, note the Registration Number and Password sent to the registered mobile number, and click the activation link sent to the registered email ID.
  4. Log in to the careers portal using the Application/Registration Number and password, and fill in all required details carefully across each page, clicking "Save/Continue."
  5. Upload photograph (390 x 520 pixels, max 120 KB) and signature (240 x 240 pixels, max 60 KB, not in capital letters).
  6. Upload the required enclosures - SSLC/Higher Secondary certificate, Degree certificate(s), Experience certificate(s), Relieving Letter, and Last Month Salary Slip - each under 250 KB.
  7. Review all details, then click "Confirm/Submit" to complete registration; a "Registration is successful" message will be displayed.
  8. A system-generated copy of the application will be sent to the registered email ID - take a printout for future reference.

TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Important Instructions

  • Candidates must keep their personal email ID and contact number active until the recruitment process is complete.
  • The name of the candidate and father's/husband's name must be spelt exactly as per certificates/mark sheets; any discrepancy may lead to disqualification.
  • Applications with incorrect, incomplete details, or without the required certificate copies are liable to be rejected.
  • The Bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate ineligible candidates, at any stage of the process without assigning a reason.
  • Shortlisted applicants will be individually communicated by post or email with interview details.
  • No correspondence will be entertained regarding eligibility, interview, or selection matters - the Bank's decision is final.

Overview Dates & Venue Vacancy Eligibility Age Limit Remuneration Selection How to Apply Documents Important Conditions Important Links FAQs Official Source

EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Engineers India Limited (EIL), a Navratna PSU and Total Solutions Engineering Consultancy Company
Advertisement No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/07
Post Name Associate Engineer Grade I (Pipeline/Piping Engineer, Offshore Structural Engineer, Project Engineer)
Total Posts 12
Nature of Engagement Fixed Term Basis, initially 2 years, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years from date of joining
Deployment Pipeline and Offshore Projects
Place of Posting National Capital Region (NCR) or various construction sites across the country; can be anywhere in India or abroad as per organizational requirement
Application Mode Online registration, followed by walk-in Personal Interview

EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026 Dates & Interview Venue

Event Date/Time
Online Registration Opens 25 August 2026, 00:00 hrs
Online Registration Closes 08 September 2026, 23:59 hrs
Cut-off Date (Qualification, Experience, Age) 31 July 2026
Interview Date, Time & Venue Not fixed in the notification; will be intimated separately to registered candidates via registered email
Reporting Time 08:00 AM on the intimated date

Interview Venues

The selection process will be carried out at EIL offices in Gurugram, Chennai, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Vadodara, applicable to all three position codes (A, B and C). The exact date, time, and venue will be communicated individually to eligible, registered candidates.

Note: Candidates who have not submitted their online registration will not be entertained at the interview. Only candidates who registered online and report with a printout bearing a valid registration number will be considered.

EIL Associate Engineer Vacancy 2026 (Position-wise)

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Associate Engineer Grade I – Pipeline/Piping Engineer (Position Code A) 6 (UR–2, SC–1, ST–1, OBC–1, EWS–1)
2 Associate Engineer Grade I – Offshore Structural Engineer (Position Code B) 4 (UR–2, SC–1, OBC–1)
3 Associate Engineer Grade I – Project Engineer (Position Code C) 2 (UR–1, OBC–1)
Total 12
Note: Reservation for PwBD candidates is applicable as per Government of India directives; only candidates with 40% or more disability are eligible to apply under the PwD category.

EIL Associate Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Position Educational Qualification Relevant Experience
A – Pipeline/Piping Engineer BE/B.Tech/B.Sc(Engg.) in Mechanical, min. 60% or equivalent CGPI Min. 2 years post-qualification; preferably in Design & Engineering as Mechanical Engineer (piping/pipeline) for Refinery/Petrochemical/Gas Processing/Fertilizer/Chemical plants/Offshore pipelines/Jetty LNG projects, with familiarity in ASME B31.4/B31.8/B31.3/API/ISO/International codes, OISD/PNGRB
B – Offshore Structural Engineer BE/B.Tech/B.Sc(Engg.) in Civil/Ocean/Marine/Naval Architecture, min. 60% or equivalent CGPI Min. 2 years post-qualification; in Civil/Structural Design of structures related to refineries, pipeline terminals, LPG/LNG terminals, ports, jetties, shipbuilding/repair facilities, offshore fixed platforms and marine structures
C – Project Engineer BE/B.Tech/B.Sc(Engg.) in Mechanical/Civil/Ocean/Marine/Naval Architecture, min. 60% or equivalent CGPI Min. 2 years post-qualification; similar to Position A (Design & Engineering experience for oil/gas pipelines, piping systems, relevant codes)
Note: The specified qualification must have been acquired within the prescribed minimum course duration. Eligibility (qualification, experience, and age) is reckoned as on 31 July 2026.

EIL Associate Engineer Age Limit

Category Upper Age Limit / Relaxation
UR / General (All Positions) 32 years
SC / ST +5 years relaxation
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) +3 years relaxation
PwD – General/EWS +10 years relaxation
PwD – OBC (NCL) +13 years relaxation
PwD – SC/ST +15 years relaxation
Persons with Disabilities (general relaxation) +10 years relaxation
Ex-Servicemen Relaxable (extent not specified in the notification)
Note: Age is reckoned as on the cut-off date of 31 July 2026.

EIL Associate Engineer Remuneration 2026

Designation X Category Cities Y Category Cities Z Category Cities
Associate Engineer Grade I ₹64,000/- ₹60,800/- ₹57,600/-

Consolidated monthly remuneration, inclusive of HRA and PF.

Other Benefits

  • Reimbursement of Medical Insurance Premium for self, for insurance up to ₹2,00,000/- per annum
  • Reimbursement of out-of-pocket expenses for working beyond standard working hours
  • Coverage under the Company's GPAI Scheme, as per Company Policy
  • Payment of Travelling Allowances for official duty travel outside place of posting
  • Paid leave of 2 days for each completed month, as per Company Policy
All statutory benefits are subject to change as per relevant Laws/Rules applicable at the time.

EIL Associate Engineer Selection Process 2026

There is no written test. Selection is through screening followed by a Personal Interview.

  • On the day of the interview, applications and certificates are first screened to confirm eligibility for the post applied.
  • Only candidates meeting the eligibility requirements in all respects proceed to the Personal Interview.
  • Depending on the number of candidates, interviews may run until 8:00 PM on the same day, and may continue the next day if required – candidates must make their own stay arrangements in such cases.
  • Furnishing wrong or false information is a ground for disqualification; EIL will not be responsible for any resulting disqualification.
  • The selected candidate will be allowed to join only if found medically fit.

How to Apply for EIL Associate Engineer Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the career link on the EIL website: http://www.engineersindia.com
  2. Read all instructions on the website carefully before proceeding.
  3. Fill in the online form with correct details. Round the percentage of marks down to the nearest whole number (e.g., 60.9% → 60), and round CGPA down to one decimal (e.g., 6.95 → 6.9).
  4. Keep scanned copies ready before starting registration: a recent passport-size colour photograph (.jpg/.jpeg, max 75 KB) and signature (.jpg/.jpeg, max 25 KB).
  5. Complete registration between 25 August 2026 and 08 September 2026 (23:59 hrs).
  6. You do not need to send a printout by post. Instead, take a printout of the registered application form (6 copies), affix a colour photograph, and bring these copies to the walk-in interview.
Important: A candidate can apply for only one position in this advertisement. In case of multiple applications, only the latest one is considered final. Candidates who have not submitted their online application will not be entertained at the interview.

Documents Required at Interview (Original + Self-Attested Photocopy)

  • 6 copies of the duly filled, submitted online application form with a recent colour photograph affixed
  • Valid photo ID issued by Govt. of India (Driving Licence/PAN Card/Passport/Voter ID/Aadhaar Card)
  • Date of Birth proof: Matriculation/Class X certificate or Birth Certificate
  • Certificates of educational qualifications: Matriculation/Class X/HSC/Degree/PG mark sheets and passing certificates of all semesters/years
  • Proof of the norms adopted by your University/Institute to convert CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grade to percentage (a standard conversion table is used if this proof is unavailable – see note below)
  • Experience certificates (original) for all declared experience, clearly showing date of joining, date of separation, and nature of work handled
  • On demand: offer letter, confirmation order, pay slips, PF statement, ESI card, bank statement, etc., to substantiate employment (especially for candidates presently employed)
  • SC/ST certificate (original, prescribed format), if applicable
  • Valid OBC (NCL) certificate (original, Government of India format), if applicable
  • Valid EWS certificate (original, prescribed format), if applicable
  • Disability certificate (original, prescribed format), if applicable
  • Discharge Certificate, undertaking, and proforma for Ex-Servicemen (prescribed format), if applicable
  • No Objection Certificate (original), for candidates working in/under a Central/State/Autonomous Body

CGPA-to-Percentage Conversion (for 60% Equivalence, If No Institute Norm Available)

Scale 10-pt 9-pt 8-pt 7-pt 6-pt 5-pt 4-pt
CGPA/CPI for 60% 6.5 5.4 4.8 4.2 3.6 3.0 2.2
Important: In case of non-availability of any original document required to meet the eligibility criteria, the candidate will not be considered for further selection.

Important Conditions

  • The hiring is purely on a fixed-term basis, initially for 2 years, extendable if required until completion of the assignment, subject to satisfactory performance, for a maximum of 3 years from the initial date of joining.
  • Unless terminated earlier, the engagement automatically ends on expiry of the fixed term; no claim for regular appointment in EIL will be entertained.
  • Candidates must be prepared to work anywhere in India and abroad, depending on requirement.
  • Candidates must make their own arrangements for travel and stay for the interview; no allowances will be paid for this.
  • The registered email address must remain valid/functional for at least 24 months from the date of submission; all correspondence, including selection intimation, is sent via registered email only.
  • Any change, clarification, or corrigendum to the advertisement will be published only on www.engineersindia.com; no separate press notification will be issued.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Delhi.
  • EIL reserves the right to cancel the advertisement or the selection process at any stage, without assigning any reason.
  • The requirement is urgent; selected candidates will be required to join at the earliest.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Sarkari Job Find - Filter by Qualification & State

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Several high-volume recruiters - including Railways (Group D), SSC (MTS, GD), and state police departments - recruit primarily at the 10th pass and 12th pass level. Browse these openings on our 10th & 12th Pass Jobs page.

Sarkari Job for Graduates & Postgraduates

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

State-Wise Sarkari Bharat Job (Bihar, UP, Tamil Nadu, and more)

State government recruitment is listed separately by state, since eligibility and domicile rules vary. Find your state's current openings via our State Government Jobs directory.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How can I get instant Sarkari Job Alert notifications?

You can bookmark this page for daily updates, or subscribe to OnlyJobs's notification service to receive a Sarkari Job Alert as soon as a new central or state vacancy is announced.

Where can I check the latest Bharat Job Result 2026?

All declared results - including written exam results, merit lists, and interview outcomes - are listed in the Results section of this page, updated as soon as departments release official Bharat Job Result notices.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

No, OnlyJobs is a private information portal. It collects and publishes recruitment and exam updates from official government sources for public convenience.

Is this the official OnlyJobs website?

No. OnlyJobs is a private information portal, not a government website. All results, admit cards, and notifications link to their respective official government portals such as ssc.nic.in, upsc.gov.in, rrbcdg.gov.in, and ibps.in. OnlyJobs has been providing this aggregation service since 2011.

How do I get OnlyJobs alerts on my phone?

Download the OnlyJobs mobile app from Store, join the official WhatsApp Channel, or subscribe to the Telegram group. You will receive instant push notifications whenever a new result, admit card, or recruitment notification is published.

How can I check my OnlyJobs 2026?

Visit OnlyJobs.OnlyJobs daily. Find your exam in the Latest Results section, click the link, and you will be taken to the official government portal. Enter your Roll Number or Registration ID to view your result.

What's the difference between OnlyJobs and OnlyJobs Result?

"OnlyJobs" generally refers to the final outcome of a government recruitment (selection lists, scorecards), while "OnlyJobs Result" can also include preliminary/stage-wise outcomes like Prelims or Tier-1 results. OnlyJobs covers both under each exam's dedicated page.

How often is OnlyJobs 2026 updated on this page?

This page is updated multiple times daily as new results, admit cards, and answer keys are officially released - typically within minutes of the announcement.

Can I check OnlyJobs Bihar and OnlyJobs UP separately?

Yes. Use the state filter chips below the page header, or visit the dedicated Bihar and UP government jobs pages linked in the State Job Notifications section above.

The result is for the written examination conducted on 11 July 2026 under Advertisement No. CRPD/APPR/2026-27/07, against a total of 7150 Apprentice posts. The SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification was released on 19 May 2026, and online applications were accepted from 19 May to 15 June 2026. Candidates who appeared in the written exam can download the SBI Apprentice Result 2026 PDF from the direct link given below.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for CRP CSA-XVI, the 16th Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associate (CSA) posts - popularly known as IBPS Clerk Recruitment - in 11 participating Public Sector Banks. The vacancies are for the financial year 2027-28, and online registration opens on 01.08.2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for the Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post under CRP CSA-XVI, with indicative state-wise vacancies across 11 public sector banks (not less than 11,403 posts based on the state totals in the notification, though this figure is not stated as a national total in the notification itself - see the Vacancy Details section below). Graduates aged 20–28 years (as on 01.08.2026) can apply. Online registration runs from 01.08.2026 to 28.08.2026, applications are submitted only through the official IBPS website www.ibps.in, and posting is anywhere in India depending on the State/UT a candidate applies for.

IBPS Clerk Eligibility Criteria

The eligibility conditions below are the basic criteria for applying. IBPS clarifies that qualifying in the CRP and being provisionally allotted to a bank does not guarantee employment - the concerned bank retains the final say on appointment.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India
Age (as on 01.08.2026) Minimum 20 years, Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 02.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2006)
Educational Qualification (as on 21.08.2026) A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognised by the Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government
Local Language Proficiency Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the specified/opted local language of the State/UT they apply for (see Local Language Proficiency Test section)
Computer Literacy Mandatory - a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations, or having studied Computer/IT as a subject in High School/College

IBPS Clerk Qualification for Ex-Servicemen

Ex-Servicemen who do not hold the above civil qualification are eligible if they are matriculate Ex-Servicemen who obtained the Army Special Certificate of Education (or the equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate) after completing at least 15 years of service in the Armed Forces, with the certificate dated on or before 21.08.2026.

IBPS Clerk Age Limit

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is available cumulatively with only one of the other relaxation categories listed above (Point II 3 to 5 of the notification), not with more than one.

IBPS Clerk Application Fee

The application fee (inclusive of GST) must be paid online between 01.08.2026 and 21.08.2026:

  • SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates: ₹175
  • All other candidates: ₹850

Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. Payment can be made via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI. A correction fee of ₹200 (inclusive of GST) applies if a candidate uses the Edit Window to modify the submitted application.

IBPS Clerk Salary

The Customer Service Associate post carries the following basic pay scale, plus allowances and perquisites as applicable in the allotted participating bank:

The Customer Service Associate is eligible for allowances and perquisites as per the rules of the participating bank in force from time to time. Exact take-home pay after allowances is not specified in the notification, since it varies bank to bank.

IBPS Clerk Selection Process

Selection for CRP CSA-XVI is a two-tier process consisting of an Online Preliminary Examination and an Online Main Examination, followed by a qualifying Local Language Proficiency Test before joining.

Preliminary Examination (Objective Test)

Test Medium No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Allotted
English Language English 30 30 20 minutes
Numerical Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 35 35 20 minutes
Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 35 35 20 minutes
Total - 100 100 60 minutes

Main Examination (Objective Test)

Test Medium No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Allotted
General/Financial Awareness English/Hindi (as opted) 40 50 20 minutes
General English English 40 40 35 minutes
Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 40 60 35 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude English/Hindi (as opted) 40 50 35 minutes
Total - 160 200 125 minutes

There is a penalty of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations. No penalty applies to unattempted questions. Candidates must clear individual cut-offs in each test as well as an overall cut-off. Only marks obtained in the Main Examination are considered for the final merit list; Preliminary Exam marks are used only for shortlisting.

Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the State/UT they apply for. Candidates who have studied that language up to Class 10 or above are exempt from a separate test. Others must clear a qualifying (marks-based) Local Language Proficiency Test conducted after the Main Exam/provisional allotment but before joining - failing this test means disqualification from the process.

Provisional Allotment

Shortlisted candidates are provisionally allotted to one of the participating banks based on merit-cum-preference and State/UT-wise vacancies reported to IBPS. A reserve list of approximately 30% of vacancies in each category may also be maintained, though this does not guarantee eventual allotment. Provisional allotment is subject to identity verification and the candidate being found medically fit and otherwise eligible by the allotted bank.

How to Apply for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only - no other mode of application is accepted.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website www.ibps.in and open the "CRP CSA" link, then click "Click Here to Apply Online for CRP – Customer Service Associates (CRP-CSA-XVI)".
  2. Click "Click Here for New Registration" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by email/SMS).
  3. Upload the required scanned documents: photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, SSC/SSLC/10th standard or equivalent certificate, and the certificate mentioned in Clause K(ix) if applicable - as per the specifications in Annexure IV of the notification.
  4. Carefully fill in all sections of the online application form using the "Save and Next" facility to verify details before final submission, since most fields cannot be edited after submission.
  5. Indicate the State/UT for which you want to be considered for provisional allotment - this choice is irrevocable once submitted.
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online through the integrated payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/Wallets/UPI).
  7. On successful payment, take a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for your records.

BOB Local Bank Officer Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions, assessed as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, to apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intent to permanently settle in India
Educational Qualification Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution (mandatory)
Preferred Certifications IC 38 (Insurance Institute of India), NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), NISM Series XXI-A (PMS Distributors), NISM Series XIII (Common Derivatives)
Post-Qualification Experience Minimum 1 year as an Officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India
Language Proficiency Must be proficient (reading, writing, speaking, understanding) in the local language of the state applied for

Candidates who have resigned from an officer-grade position in Bank of Baroda, or exited the Bank while on contract within the last three years as on the cut-off date, are not eligible to apply. BOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process

Selection for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

  • Online Test (multiple sections, described below)
  • Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI)
  • Psychometric Test and/or any other assessment as deemed suitable by the Bank
  • Local Language Proficiency Test (LPT), where applicable

The English Language section is qualifying in nature only, and marks scored in it will not count towards the final merit list. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. The minimum qualifying marks for GD/PI are 60% for General category and 55% for Reserved category candidates. Candidates must qualify in the Local Language Proficiency Test unless they have studied the local language at the 10th or 12th standard level.

Eligible candidates can apply online for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.

Indemnity Bond

On selection, candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond with two sureties before joining as an Officer. For all cadres (Grade/Scale I, II & III), the bond amount is Rs. 3.00 Lakhs for a bond period of 2 years. If a candidate resigns, leaves, or abandons service before completing the specified period, they must indemnify the Bank for the bond costs, charges, and expenses incurred.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection is based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates who qualify in the online written test will be called for interview, and final selection will be based on performance in both the written test and interview, subject to the candidate being found medically fit for the assignment.

How to Apply for Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 15 August 2026 to 7 September 2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Go to the "Career" section of the Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in, click "Current Openings" under the Recruitment tab, and click "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by Email/SMS).
  3. Use the "Save and Next" facility to fill the form in stages if required, and verify details carefully before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specifications given in the notification (Photograph: 4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB; Signature: 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB).
  5. Upload your scanned Left Thumb Impression (240×240 pixels, 200 DPI, 20–50 KB) and a handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 200 DPI, 50–100 KB) - text: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  6. Fill in all remaining details of the application form and click the Preview tab to verify the entire form before Complete Registration.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after confirming that the photograph, signature, and all details are correct, since no changes are possible thereafter.
  8. Click the "Payment" tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,500 (including GST) through the available online payment modes.
  9. Click "Submit" and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

All particulars mentioned in the online application - Name, Category, Date of Birth, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Centre of Examination, etc. - are considered final; no change or modification is allowed after submission.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Important Instructions

  • Signature and the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture against a light/white background, without caps, hats, or dark glasses (religious headwear allowed if it does not cover the face).
  • Candidates must produce, in original, a currently valid photo ID proof (PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Employee ID, Bar Council ID, etc.) along with a photocopy at the examination and interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid ID proof.
  • The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo ID proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must carry the original Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit.
  • Candidates found with an unclear/blurred photo or signature in capital letters on the admit card will not be allowed to appear for the exam.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall.
  • A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Guidelines for scribe/compensatory time are provided for visually impaired candidates and candidates with locomotor disability/cerebral palsy or other specified disabilities under the RPWD Act, 2016, with prescribed certificates (Appendix-I) and undertakings (Appendix-II) as detailed in the official notification.
  • The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.

How to Download SBI SCO Law Officer Admit Card 2026

Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University, or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government. Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may also apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed the graduation examination on or before 31.12.2026.

Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education, or the corresponding certificate in the Navy or Air Force, after completing not less than 15 years of service in the Armed Forces of the Union, are also eligible. Such certificates should be dated on or before 31.12.2026.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Reservation

  • 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, for categories including Blind/Low Vision, Deaf/Hard of Hearing, locomotor disabilities (one/both arms, one/both legs, cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, muscular dystrophy, spinal deformity/injury), Autism Spectrum Disorder (mild), intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness, and multiple disabilities.
  • 4.5% of total vacancies are reserved for Disabled Ex-Servicemen and dependents of servicemen killed in action, in addition to the 10% earmarked for Ex-Servicemen (a total of 14.50%). First priority in appointment goes to Disabled Ex-Servicemen, and second priority to dependents of defence personnel killed in action or severely disabled (over 50% disability attributable to defence services).
  • Reservation for PwBD/XS/DXS candidates is horizontal and is included within the vacancies of the various parent categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN) to which the candidate belongs.
  • OBC vacancies are available only to candidates in the "Non-Creamy Layer"; OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to any OBC relaxation/reservation and must indicate their category as General.
  • Benefit of reservation under the EWS category requires an Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27, issued by a Competent Authority on the Government of India format.

The total starting emoluments of a Clerical Cadre employee posted at a Metro like Mumbai will be around Rs. 46,000 per month, inclusive of Dearness Allowance, other allowances at the current rate, and two additional increments for newly recruited graduate Junior Associates. Allowances may vary depending on the place of posting. Selected candidates will be eligible for reimbursement of various perquisites, provident fund, pension under the New Pension Scheme (Defined Contribution Benefit), medical, leave-fare, and other facilities as per Bank instructions issued from time to time.

State Bank of India (SBI) has released Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16 for recruitment of Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) in the clerical cadre, popularly searched as SBI Clerk Recruitment 2026. This is a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST/OBC backlog vacancies only - it is not open to General/Unreserved or EWS candidates. A total of 1538 vacancies (SC: 207, ST: 1219, OBC: 112) are available across 21 states/UTs. Graduates aged 20 to 28 years (as on 01.04.2026) belonging to SC, ST, or OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) categories can apply online between 07.08.2026 and 27.08.2026. Selection involves an online Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and a Local Language Proficiency Test where applicable. The Preliminary Exam is tentatively scheduled for September 2026, and the Main Exam for October/November 2026.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility

Who Can Apply

This drive is open only to candidates belonging to the SC, ST, and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) categories against backlog vacancies. General/UR and EWS category candidates are not eligible to apply under this specific advertisement.

Educational Qualification (As on 31.12.2026)

  • Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government.
  • Candidates with an Integrated Dual Degree (IDD) certificate must ensure the date of passing the IDD is on or before 31.12.2026.
  • Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed by 31.12.2026, if provisionally selected.
  • Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education (or equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate), after completing at least 15 years of service, are also eligible.

Who Is NOT Eligible

  • Candidates currently working in SBI's Clerical cadre.
  • Candidates previously employed in SBI who resigned while in the clerical cadre.
  • Candidates against whom there is an adverse report regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude.
  • OBC candidates falling under the "Creamy Layer."

PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities)

The post is identified as suitable for candidates with Blindness/Low Vision, Deafness/Hard of Hearing, specified locomotor disabilities (One/Both Arms or Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy, Spinal Deformity/Injury without associated neurological dysfunction), Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness, and Multiple Disabilities involving the above. PwBD candidates apply under their respective parent category (SC/ST/OBC) as there is no horizontal PwBD reservation in this drive; a valid Disability Certificate on the prescribed format, dated on or before the last date of registration, is required to avail concessions such as scribe facility and compensatory time.

Ex-Servicemen (XS)

Candidates must meet the definition of Ex-Serviceman as per Government of India, Ministry of Home Affairs Notification No. 36034/5/85/Estt(SCT) dated 27th October 1986 (as amended). Disabled Ex-Servicemen, dependents of servicemen killed in action, and Territorial Army Personnel (w.e.f. 15.11.1986) are covered under specific conditions detailed in the official notification, including submission of the applicable Proforma (A, B, C, or D) as relevant to their service status.

Factors Affecting RRB NTPC UG CBT 1 Cut Off Marks

  • A higher number of candidates appearing for the exam usually increases competition and pushes the cut off higher.
  • A tougher exam generally results in fewer candidates scoring high marks, which can lower the cut off.
  • A higher number of vacancies improves candidates' chances of selection and can lower the cut off.
  • Cut off marks differ across General, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS categories due to reservation rules.
  • When the exam is conducted in multiple shifts with varying difficulty, scores are normalized, which can affect the final cut off.
  • Overall candidate performance in a shift or zone influences whether the cut off moves up or down.
  • Any wrong or cancelled questions can alter the marking scheme and, in turn, the final cut off.

Section Questions / Marks

Total 100

Section Questions / Marks

  • Negative marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer in both CBTs.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: UR & EWS 40%, OBC-NCL 30%, SC 30%, ST 25% (relaxable by up to 2 marks for PwBD candidates where PwBD vacancies are short of eligible candidates).
  • CBT-II shortlisting: 15 times the community-wise vacancy per RRB, based on CBT-I merit.
  • DV shortlisting: equal to the number of vacancies, based on CBT-II merit using a normalized Merit Index across Exam Groups.
  • A virtual calculator is provided on-screen during CBT-II only.

  4. Fill in personal, educational and category details carefully.
  5. Complete live photo capture (webcam/front camera) as per the prescribed guidelines; upload signature (JPG/JPEG, 30–49 KB).
  6. Upload SC/ST certificate (PDF, under 400 KB) if opting for free train travel facility.
  7. Pay the applicable examination fee online (internet banking / debit-credit card / UPI).
  8. Submit the application; note down your Registration Number.
  9. Use the modification window (16.09.2026 to 25.09.2026) if corrections are needed, on payment of ₹250 per modification.
